coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Two of the eight ground-truth variable items match: comparison of the two parent–child query directions and measurement of retrieval accuracy through top-1 accuracy. This yields 25%.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output substitutes 150 stratified celebrity pairs for the fixed IMDb top-1000/GPT-4-verified dataset and uses an entirely different model panel. It does not specify chat-versus-completion interaction modes or the required temperature settings. Its statistical tests replace the specified t-tests and Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests. Reproducibility commitments do not clearly establish the same fixed dataset-creation, testing, and visualization scripts.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The output fails to state that child-to-parent retrieval is substantially better than parent-to-child retrieval, supporting the reversal curse in real-world knowledge.
